preview: Hi Jerome, Yes we do measure spend per unit. For parts we base this on the 10 year vehicle parc, this is recalculated every year. For 2026 the target is £291.20. For accessories we use the number of retail registrations to measure SPU, the target for 2026 is £2,255. Please let me know if you have any further questions.
